message.femboycompanion.refuse3: Femboy: This is your last warning!
message.femboycompanion.angry_start: The femboy pulls out a wooden sword!
message.femboycompanion.angry: The femboy is angry and does not listen to you.
message.femboycompanion.ignore: Femboy: Get lost, you annoy me.
message.femboycompanion.distrust: Femboy: You hurt one of us. I will not trade with you.
message.femboycompanion.trust: The femboy takes your offering. Trust: %s%%
advancements.femboycompanion.root.title: Femboys
Find a white femboy walking in the world and come within 10 blocks of him.
Find a black femboy walking in the world and come within 10 blocks of him.
advancements.femboycompanion.gift.title: Gift From a Femboy
advancements.femboycompanion.gift.desc: Walk up to a femboy and right-click him with an empty hand to get a gift.
advancements.femboycompanion.kill.title: First Blood
advancements.femboycompanion.kill.desc: Kill a femboy. Other femboys nearby will remember it.
advancements.femboycompanion.sword.title: Wooden Sword
advancements.femboycompanion.sword.desc: Annoy a femboy or hit him, and he will pull out a wooden sword.
advancements.femboycompanion.placated.de: Calm down an angry femboy by giving him food or flowers.
advancements.femboycompanion.get_ears.de: Get a femboy ear. It drops from a femboy or can be crafted from wool.
advancements.femboycompanion.get_double_: Craft two ears of the same color into a pair.
advancements.femboycompanion.get_tail.de: Get a femboy tail. It drops from a femboy or can be crafted from wool and a lead.
advancements.femboycompanion.get_paws.de: Get femboy paws. They drop from a femboy or can be crafted from wool and leather boots.
message.femboycompanion.pockets_full: Femboy: My pockets are full, I can't take more.
message.femboycompanion.wait: The femboy will give gifts again in %s
message.femboycompanion.wait_ready: The femboy is ready to give gifts
